probes.What is a toothbrush?: A toothbrush is a tool used for cleaning teeth. It consists of a handle and a head with bristles, which are usually made of nylon. People use toothbrushes to remove food particles, plaque, and bacteria from their teeth and gums. Regular brushing helps maintain good oral hygiene and prevent dental problems like cavities and gum disease. The bristles are designed to reach between teeth and along the gum line for thorough cleaning. Some toothbrushes have soft, medium, or hard bristles, and they can be manual or electric. probes.How do people usually clean their teeth?:
People usually clean their teeth by brushing them twice a day with a toothbrush and toothpaste, and flossing once a day to remove food particles and plaque from between the teeth. Some people also use mouthwash as part of their oral hygiene routine. It's important to clean your teeth regularly to prevent tooth decay and gum disease. probes.What is dental floss?:
Dental floss is a thin, flexible thread used to clean between teeth and under the gumline, where a toothbrush cannot reach. It helps remove plaque, food particles, and bacteria that can lead to cavities and gum disease. There are various types, including waxed, unwaxed, flavored, and floss picks, to suit different needs. Regular use of dental floss is an essential part of oral hygiene.สติ

probes.What are human teeth made of?: Human teeth are made of several different materials, including enamel, dentin, and cementum. Enamel is the outermost layer of the tooth and is the hardest substance in the human body. It is made up of calcium and phosphate minerals. Dentin is the layer beneath the enamel and makes up the bulk of the tooth. It is made up of collagen fibers and mineral crystals. Cementum is the layer that covers the root of the tooth and helps to attach the tooth to the surrounding bone. The pulp, which is the innermost layer of the tooth, contains blood vessels and nerves. probes.What is a bicycle?: A bicycle, also known as a bike or cycle, is a human-powered, pedal-driven, single-track vehicle, having two wheels attached to a frame, one behind the other. A bicycle rider is called a cyclist, or bicyclist. The basic bicycle evolved from the "velocipede" in 1817 into modern times. The most common type, the "safety bicycle", has a frame, front and rear wheels with equal sized tires, and a saddle.
